caption: The drawing shows a single ceramic pot positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The pot itself is cylindrical with a slightly flared rim, decorated with a raised braided or twisted pattern near the lip. The exterior surface of the pot is a warm yellowish-brown, with areas of darker brown, particularly on the inside and the rim. The surface features painted decoration, including a leafy branch design with reddish-brown leaves on both sides. In the center, in cursive script, the pot is labeled "Leah Phipps Harmony Hall." The shading and highlights give the pot a three-dimensional appearance. Near the bottom right edge of the pot, there is a small signature or inscription by the artist in red. There are no other objects in the composition.
title: Pa. German Flower Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
